inclusions.source: The hotel transfer is private to your party; the semi-submarine itself is a shared vessel carrying up to 44 passengers, run by its crew.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The trip takes bookings from a single seat upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is provided.

inclusions.text: Private, air-conditioned hotel pickup to the Sinbad pier
inclusions.source: Hotel pickup comes first — a private, air-conditioned transfer from your Hurghada accommodation to the Sinbad pier, roughly 20 to 30 minutes depending on where you're staying in the resort strip.
After the underwater-viewing phase, the vessel returns to the pier and a transfer takes you back to your hotel.
